findings.description: For a fault-free start-up with no start-up refresh, the requirement bounds the time to the first refresh under SWR-WDG-004 even if a fault is detected after start-up and before that refresh. SWR-WDG-001 prohibits watchdog servicing from fault detection until reset.
findings.requested_change: Condition the obligation to make the first refresh on no fault being detected before that refresh, consistent with SWR-WDG-001.

findings.description: The requirement combines independently judgeable bounds for consecutive refreshes, the first refresh after enabling, the end of start-up, and the no-refresh transition. One bound can fail while the others pass.
findings.requested_change: Split the independently verifiable timing obligations into separate requirements, preserving their applicable conditions and transition coverage.
